articles.title: Galaxy, Sharplink plan $125M institutional DeFi yield fund backed by ETH treasury
articles.snippet: Sharplink will contribute $100 million in staked Ether to a Galaxy-managed fund as institutions seek to earn yield from crypto holdings without selling ETH.

articles.title: 7 Democrats seen as ‘key’ to advancing CLARITY Act: Galaxy
articles.snippet: The CLARITY Act, introduced in July 2025, stalled in January after Coinbase withdrew its support for the legislation over concerns about legal protections and stablecoin yields.

articles.title: Ethereum Firm Sharplink Posts $686 Million Loss, Kicks Off $125M Yield Fund With Galaxy
articles.snippet: Sharplink posted a quarterly net loss of nearly $686 million, but shares are up following word of a $125 million collaboration with Galaxy.
